categories.name: Housekeeping & Cleaning
categories.description: Daily cleaning for offices, factories, and commercial spaces.
categories.longDescription: Housekeeping services on CSVN cover routine cleaning for corporate offices, factories, warehouses, hospitals, hotels, and commercial complexes across India. Common scopes include daily sweeping and mopping, washroom sanitation, waste collection, glass and facade cleaning, and periodic deep cleaning. Corporate buyers typically evaluate housekeeping vendors on trained manpower, supervisor-to-staff ratios, statutory compliance, and the ability to scale across multiple sites. Many facilities now bundle housekeeping with pest control, waste management, and landscaping under an integrated facility management contract. Listings on CSVN show vendor contact details, service areas, and city coverage so procurement teams can shortlist providers directly without going through middlemen. Listing on CSVN does not guarantee enquiries, contracts, or orders. It provides visibility to decision-makers browsing the directory.
